mainEntity.name: Should I use green board or regular drywall in my basement walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most Denver-area basements, moisture-resistant or mold-resistant drywall is the safer choice, especially for below-grade walls. The right board depends on how dry the space stays, whether there are past moisture issues, and whether the walls are against concrete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use moisture-resistant drywall when basement walls are below grade or have any moisture risk. Regular drywall can work in dry areas, but Denver basements often benefit from a more moisture-tolerant product.
